title: Fix a concurrency-limited map
prompt: mapLimit(items, limit, fn) in pool.js should call the async fn(item, index) for every item with at most `limit` calls running at once, and resolve to the results in input order. If a call rejects, the returned promise rejects with that error as soon as it happens, and no call that has not started yet is started. An empty array resolves to []. A limit that is not a positive integer throws a RangeError synchronously. The current version gets several of these wrong. Fix it. Do not change test.js.
